mainEntity.name: How does splitly calculate group balances?

acceptedAnswer.text: splitly uses an intelligent greedy debt simplification algorithm to minimize total payments between group members into the fewest possible direct transactions.

mainEntity.name: Is my financial expense data stored on a central server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. splitly stores 100% of your session and expense data locally inside your device browser using IndexedDB. No accounts or server logins are required.

mainEntity.name: How do temporary trip share links work?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you generate a share link, a temporary copy of your trip data is uploaded for 24 hours. Friends can import the trip directly into their browser, after which the link automatically expires and deletes itself.

mainEntity.name: Can I use splitly without an internet connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! You can add splitly to your phone's home screen with 1 tap for a full native app experience. It runs completely offline without internet.
